item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:16 AM 13 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Guimaras(NuevaValencia), #Capiz(Panitan, Dao, Cuartero and Dumarao) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Samar(Matuguinao, Gandara, SanJorge, SanJoseDeBuan), #Guimaras(Jordan, Sibunag), #Iloilo(Lemery, BarotacViejo, SanRafael, Sara, Concepcion, Carles, Balasan, Estancia, Batad, SanDionisio, Ajuy), #Capiz(Pontevedra, MaAyon, Pilar and PresidentRoxas) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
